verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is an on-premises GPU server that customers own and operate. A vendor training-data opt-out is a policy axis for hosted AI services, not a capability a hardware platform ships, so this story is a category error for the product type. The self-encrypting drives in the evidence are an adjacent storage-security feature and are not credited toward a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
